name: time domain green’s function
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 以时域脉冲响应表示系统动力作用的方法。
usage_overview: 时域格林函数以单位脉冲引起的响应为基础，用于重构外部荷载作用下的受迫振动。在车辆—轨道动力分析中，可通过卷积求解线性轨道板—底座等下部结构子系统的振动响应。

complete_examples.text: For the derivation of the time domain Green’s function, there are two numerical methods.
In this present study, the symmetric and periodical properties of the track slab-soil system are fully utilized to generate the time domain Green’s function.
